display_name: Penal Code 1871 — the whole Code, to the charge generator's contract
versions_encoded: Penal Code 1871 as consolidated on Singapore Statutes Online, "Current version as at 09 Sep 2026" (registers/source-bundle/PC1871.txt, a converter's plain-text rendering, not the official text)

scope.encoded: All 600 sections of the Code's table of contents have a disposition, taking each section's best disposition: 524 encoded, 75 repealed or blank in this text, 1 inert (s 1, a short title: machinery), 0 deferred, 0 fork. Version 0.2.0 (completion pass of 2026-11-04) encoded the 42 sections that 0.1.0 deferred (ss 301, 304B, 304C, 308A, 310, 311, 314, 315, 316, 335A; ss 372, 373, 373A, 376B-376H, 377, 377B, 377BB-377BO, 377C) in pc-body-a-deferred, pc-body-b-deferred and pc-body-b-deferred-images, and moved 28 sections (ss 2, 3, 5, 6, 6A, 7, 8, 9, 12, 17, 22A, 29A, 29B, 32, 33, 36, 38, 42, 44A, 45-51, 54, 108B) and 19 sub-provisions (ss 376A(1B), 376AA(2), 79(2), 79 Explanations 1 and 2, 79A(2), 80(2), 86(2), 86(3), 26C(3), 26C(4), 26C Explanation, 53 Explanation, and the jurisdiction subsections 73(3), 74(3), 74A(4), 74B(4), 74C(4), 74D(4)) out of inert into pc-general-moved. 391 punishing provisions each have a facts record, a defining predicate, `offence under s N` and `charge under s N` returning a Charge that refuses with the missing elements when not made out (CPC 2010 s 123(5)); 344 at 0.1.0 and 47 more at 0.2.0. Chapters 4 and 4A create no offence and export `exception under s N` ladders instead. A function answers JUST FALSE only where the text says no in its own words and NOTHING (or a named constructor such as `not covered by this Explanation`) everywhere else; NOTES.md has the readings that rest on a lawyer's judgement. Illustrations are the main source of tests. 179 forks are registered in notes/<group>-forks.md and 22 in notes/deferred-forks.md.
scope.inert: s 1 (short title) and s 4B(3) (the Minister may amend the Schedule by order), reason 2, machinery; the title and edition statement, the long title, the enactment date, the 26 chapter headings, and the Legislative History, Abbreviations and Comparative Table, reason 1, not operative. The 75 repealed sections are reason 3, shown repealed in the text, and are dispositioned `repealed or blank in this text`.

not_reviewed: No domain expert has read this row against the text; no lawyer has read any of it, the 0.2.0 modules included. The text is a converter's plain-text rendering of Singapore Statutes Online, which is an unofficial consolidation. No independent test pass has been run: every test was written by the agent that wrote the code it tests, and the tests of 0.2.0 find a slip between the agent's reading and the L4, not a misreading of the text (eighteen mutations of the L4 were all caught). It is not a cleanroom: the encoders read the `legalese` row as the pattern for the charge generator's contract. The readings marked marginal in NOTES.md (a failed "if" and a flat negative as the text's no; a grant limited by its own wording as not the text's no) have not been put to a lawyer. One reading was ruled by Meng Wong on 2026-09-26: "above 18 years of age" means 18 or older.

pc-general-part-tests.l4.why: Findings about the Code, left red on purpose: s 118's Illustration treats gang-robbery as punishable with death or life imprisonment, which s 395 no longer provides (fork GP-14); s 512(4)'s Illustration treats attempted robbery under s 512, where s 393 now makes express provision (fork GP-10).
